resources.string: Direct English input; no Pinyin or Chinese conversion. Reveal to check; typing hides it again. Paste and cursor movement are unavailable; clear to retype.
Random keys currently require manual transcription; no copy, paste or export. Long keys are difficult to transcribe. Prefer a passphrase or key file across devices. Reveal to check.
Editing clears the current result. Secret text, credentials and key file have already been cleared and must be entered or selected again. Continue?

Device biometrics + passphrase

For your own use on this device. Each encryption and decryption requires strong biometrics and your passphrase. Any qualifying fingerprint or face enrolled on this device may authenticate. Switching devices, uninstalling, clearing app data or changing biometric enrollment may permanently prevent decryption.

Open personal notes? Current drafts and the passphrase will be cleared. For decryption only the encrypted carrier will be carried over. Edit and save on the new page. For your own use on this device, each operation requires an enrolled strong biometric and your passphrase. Changing devices, reinstalling, clearing app data or enrolling new biometrics can permanently prevent recovery.
Received text format
\? Help

Unicode keeps the message less noticeable. Use it when the receiving app preserves special characters. Visible Base64url is easier to see and suits channels that strip formatting. Natural wording needs more space for a short message.
For Unicode or Base64url, paste the entire message and use auto-detect. For verse or prose, select the style used by the sender. A detached ciphertext also needs the exact original cover.
